notes: Isolated real move objects at frame 0 with fixed +X aim; no preceding chain hitstun. Steps use the real starter with no invulnerability. Frame 0 means before the first simulation advance. Collision/player separation still run. Up/down are the two sidestep directions. 240f follow-through includes all pulses, later projectile catches and cinematic resolution. Attack states are isolated fixture setups, not claims every chain link can start from idle. Manual double taps need the first tap two frames before the listed actual step start.
